admission.justification: A child server resolving a different user configuration can address the real installation instead of the selected host.

applicability: A role launch's generated bound task-tool-server environment.
conditions: Carry XDG_CONFIG_HOME when supplied so launch and child tool server resolve the same installation host.
Carry environment facts only; do not write settings.
exclusions: An unset variable remains unset; no fabricated configuration root.

origin.handoffEntry: L113 ruling 2026-10-13 00:44 / the carried configuration folder

statement: `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is among the variables a launch carries into an agent's tool server, so that the server reads the settings file the launching process read and its role tools address the same host.
